headline: Tabled site plan at 38 Jackman Road; approved Broadview Farm and Annex plans minus loop B by 6-1 vote.
summary: Land Manager Beth Carver's budgeted hours rose from 50 to 80 per month. Dues of $850 were approved, and the 38 Jackman Road site plan was tabled after wetland concerns came up during a site walk. Another agreement requires future subcommittee meetings to have minutes that list the agenda, location, and time.
decisions: Tabled the site plan review for Tax Map 7 Lot 77, 38 Jackman Road, until more information is gained about changes to the site.
Approved the minutes of October 5, 2026, unanimously.
Agreed that future subcommittee meetings must have minutes that include the agenda, location, and time.
Increased the Land Manager's budgeted hours from 50 to 80 hours per month, unanimously.
Approved $850 in annual membership dues from the Administrative Account, unanimously.
Approved the proposed plans for Broadview Farm and Broadview Annex, minus loop B, by a 6-1 vote.
